control_flow: followInTheDark: if right light < 60: if left light < 45 curve left (15/35); elif line tracker > 95 curve right (35/15); else call avoidWalls; else call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if left light < 70: if obstacle left turn right 20°; elif obstacle right turn left 20°; else call driveInTheDark; else call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if left light < 70: drive forward 30 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if obstacle ahead: stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if line tracker sees black: curve left (10/40); else curve right (40/10).

likely_intent.description: In dim light (a tunnel), follow a black line when there is one under the robot and drive straight when there is none; in bright light, follow the line and stop at a wall ahead.

decision_points.condition: the right light sensor reads below 60 % (well inside a tunnel)

branches.outcome: right light below 60 % (dim): goes on to check the left light and the line
right light 60 % or more (bright): calls avoidWalls

decision_points.condition: first: left light below 45 %; second: the line tracker above 95 % (white band)

branches.outcome: left light below 45 % (deep in the tunnel): curves left, left wheel 15 %, right 35 %
left light 45 % or more and the line tracker above 95 % (white band): curves right, left wheel 35 %, right 15 %
left light 45 % or more and the line tracker 95 % or less: calls avoidWalls

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads below 70 % (dim)

branches.outcome: left light below 70 % (dim): checks the obstacle sensors left and right
left light 70 % or more (bright): calls driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: first: an obstacle on the left; second: an obstacle on the right

branches.outcome: an obstacle on the left: turns right 20°
no obstacle on the left, an obstacle on the right: turns left 20°
no obstacle on the left or right: calls driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads below 70 % (dim)

branches.outcome: left light below 70 % (dim): drives forward at 30 %
left light 70 % or more (bright): calls stopAtWall
sees black: curves left, left wheel 10 %, right 40 %
no black: curves right, left wheel 40 %, right 10 %

scenarios.coded_response: On the white band it curves right (35/15); deep in the tunnel it curves left (15/35); on black it drives straight.

scenarios.coded_response: It drives forward at 30 %; when a wall is on its left it turns right 20°, on its right it turns left 20°.
scenarios.initial_condition: Inside a tunnel (dim light) on plain floor with no line; the tunnel may bend.
scenarios.trigger: No line under it; a tunnel wall may come in front of it.
scenarios.title: In the dark without a line, drives on
assumptions: You didn't say what to do at a bend; turning to stay off the walls keeps it driving on.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It drives straight ahead, turning to stay off the tunnel walls.

uncertainties: The line tracker reads the floor in a tunnel too, so 'in the dark' does not change what the line tracker sees; the light sensors are what detect the tunnel.
Deep in a tunnel (left light below 45 %) the robot always curves left, even with no line, so it may not drive straight there.
The robot must be more than about 10 cm inside a tunnel for the dark branch (right light below 60 %); near the opening it still behaves as in the light.
In a bend near an opening the left and right light sensors can read differently, and the program checks the right light first.
The dark line-following curves left when deep and right on the white band; it may not keep the robot on the line as in the light.
